thread:
alex: Heads-up — I captured a weird per-rank idle in the latest kv-prefetch branch. Nsight shows rank2 sitting idle ~12ms between a big gather and the all-reduce while others keep computing. attaching quick notes/heatmap.

maria: Can you paste the nvprof/custom-timers output? if kernel selection fell back for rank2 that could explain the stall.

alex: here's a tiny excerpt from our custom timers (step 63-66):
```
# rank,phase,compute_ms,comm_ms,kernel_id
0,forward,9.2,2.1,k18
1,forward,8.9,2.3,k18
2,forward,8.7,12.1,k42
3,forward,9.0,2.0,k18
```

jeff: interesting — kernel_id k42 is the fallback matmul path we see when sequence len spikes. that kernel has poor occupancy on Ampere when batch dims are uneven.

sara: another vector: check KV-cache eviction patterns. if rank2 is doing extra prefetch/rehydration it can delay its compute and push it into the all-reduce window.

alex: capturing nsight qdrep now, also exported timeline->json and timers.csv to /tmp/perf/171820. I can share links when upload finishes.

maria: proposed repro command (run from ci node across 4 ranks):
```
for RANK in 0 1 2 3; do \
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$RANK NVPROF_LOGFILE=nvprof.$RANK.out \
  nvprof --profile-from-start off --log-file nvprof.$RANK.txt \
    ./bazel-bin/redwood/serving/infer_bin --config tests/perf/kv-prefetch.cfg &
 done; wait
```

jeff: also try forcing kernel hint to k18 on all ranks (env KERNEL_HINT=k18) to see if imbalance goes away. if it does, then kernel selection heuristics need tie-break across partitions.

sara: I can produce a Sankey-like comm/compute handoff view from the nsight timeline export (small python script). that makes it obvious which rank handoff path dominates.

alex: uploaded artifacts: https://s3.redwood/perf/1718201234/nsight.qdrep and https://s3.redwood/perf/1718201234/timers.csv — nvprof logs at nvprof.{0..3}.txt in the same prefix.

ops-bot: perf-capture job 123 completed :white_check_mark: artifacts at s3://redwood-perf/1718201234/

maria: next steps: 1) rerun with KERNEL_HINT=k18 2) run with aligned microbatch padding (pad tokens on faster ranks) 3) collect nsight + timers and run sankey exporter. who wants to take #2?

jeff: I'll sketch the microbatch pad change and push a small experiment branch. should be quick.

alex: thanks. running the forced-kernel capture now, will post diffs when done. initial hypothesis: a combo of kernel fallback + sporadic KV-eviction puts rank2 in the wrong critical path, causing ~10ms tail latency on allreduce which kills parallel efficiency.
